notes: Fixture images are real product screenshots. Eval 3 is a deliberate near-miss: a single screenshot and a narrow question, where building a whole brief would be over-triggering.

evals.name: explicit-review-request
evals.prompt: We prototyped two directions for the analytics screen this week and I need the team to pick one on Monday. Shots are at /home/user/voice-capture/.claude/skills/design-brief/evals/fixtures — dashboard-light.jpg and dashboard-dark.jpg are direction A in both themes, list-view.jpg and detail-view.jpg are direction B. Put something together I can send round so people actually decide rather than just nodding at it.
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained HTML page with all four images inlined, figures with captions that make claims, and a decisions section separating settled from open, published as an Artifact.

evals.name: implicit-recap
evals.prompt: can you summarise where the settings and overlay work got to this sprint? screenshots in /home/user/voice-capture/.claude/skills/design-brief/evals/fixtures (settings.jpg, overlay.jpg, dashboard-dark.jpg). i want to look back at it later
evals.expected_output: Recognises this needs a durable brief rather than chat prose, and adds a decisions list even though the user did not ask for one.

evals.name: near-miss-single-question
evals.prompt: quick one — does the spacing under the header in /home/user/voice-capture/.claude/skills/design-brief/evals/fixtures/settings.jpg look off to you? feels tight
evals.expected_output: Answers the question directly. Does NOT build or publish an HTML brief for a single narrow question.
